dedupe_keys.name: article dataset impact of natural gas composition on green hydrogen blending capacity in the portuguese high pressure gas network

description: The deposit provides hourly steady-state optimisation outputs for hydrogen blending under alternative natural-gas compositions. An Excel workbook separates node thermodynamics and operations from pipeline-branch parameters. The provider is Joao Paulo Fontoura de Oliveira. Coverage: The example is the 62-kilometre Sines–Setúbal corridor in Portugal, abstracted into six nodes and five pipe segments. An observational calendar is not established. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: These are nonlinear-programming outputs generated using IPOPT. Global LNG compositions are scenario inputs, not evidence that all such blends operated in this corridor. For simulation it supports comparison of blending constraints and the effect of gas composition on calculated operating states. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
